description:
About the job

Description

At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

About This Role

As a Lead Software Development Engineer, it’s up to you to define, design and refine the tech that keeps us one step ahead of listeners. Anticipate. Innovate. Bring challenging ideas and we’ll support you with the latest tech, tools and systems that you need to succeed. You’ll drive the team forward, guiding them over every obstacle and leading the way to develop exciting, original and effective solutions. Leading the way, you’ll bring our team together to build and maintain our platform to bring thousands of stories to millions of listeners and unleash the power of the human voice.

About The Team

Joining our team provides the unique challenge and opportunity to deliver software that benefits many customers around the world. Marketing Technology (MarTech) team's mission is to develop systems and tools that enable marketers to provide customers multi-touch, personalized and timely messages that enhance the experience of using our services. Customer journey automation and real-time targeting are examples of systems that the team works on. These systems are built using cutting edge technologies and products from AWS like Kinesis, S3, EMR, Elastic Search, etc.

About You

You’re in your element when you’re being challenged, and you’re always eager to share your ideas, take on responsibility and keep developing at an exciting pace. We look for people who show initiative, set their standards high and see every failure as an opportunity to learn. You’re looking for an environment where you can thrive and help your team reach their potential. With opportunities to challenge yourself and lead a talented team to success, you’ll find what you’re looking for at Audible.

As a Lead Software Development Engineer, you will...


 Lead complex technical initiatives within your team
 Mentor and support other developers by cultivating curiosity and deep technical understanding
 Explore technical needs and bring solutions to the table
 Establish and follow good engineering practices
 Lead technical design reviews and provide architectural guidance


About Audible

Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

A day in the life

Basic Qualifications


 5+ years experience of software development and deployment of distributed multi-tier applications
 Experience taking a lead role delivering complex software systems to internal or external customers
 Prior use of AWS technologies at scale in a production environment
 Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience in the Advertising Technology domain, such as building integrations and pipelines with major media players (Meta, Google, etc.), implementing market leading MarTech and AdTech platforms: CRM, CDP, DMP, DSP, Ad Server, Programmatic buying, Search bidding and buying, Programmatic, Attribution, etc.
 Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate complex and ambiguous situations
 History of delivering customer-driven software products at a high scale in a fast paced, technology first, rapid-growth company
 Competency at delegating work in parallel to accelerate delivery
 Enthusiasm for promoting high-quality standard in others across: documentation, unit testing, code reviews, test automation, continuous integration and deployment

This is a commercial, relationship‑led role where your success is defined by the caliber of VIP delegates you engage, the trusted relationships you build, and the exceptional on‑site experiences you help deliver—playing an active role in curating powerful peer‑to‑peer connections and meaningful industry networking.

Build and execute targeted outreach plans to secure C-level and senior decision-makers for assigned events.

Maintain accurate CRM records (Salesforce preferred): outreach activity, statuses, notes, and follow-ups.

1+ years outbound B2B acquisition experience (events/conferences, media, communities, or similar).

Strong outbound prospecting across LinkedIn, email, phone, and referrals.

Partnership/community development mindset—comfortable building relationships that convert into attendance.

Event industry experience preferred; understanding of audience composition and delegate acquisition is a plus.


To apply, please upload your updated resume in English. 

Location: CDMX

What’s in it For You?


Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.

Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.


About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

You track what actually matters: organic lead volume, cost per lead from search, and rankings for high-intent keywords. Collaborate with Content on topical authority strategy, content briefs, and publication cadence
Communicate clearly with Operations and leadership on performance, risks, and opportunities

Internal Campaigns

Manage LionHead's own organic presence and SEO strategy held to the same standard as client work




How We Measure Success

Keyword ranking improvements for high-intent, case-driving terms.
Verified lead volume from organic,local & Ai search per account per month.
Organic traffic growth month-over-month across managed accounts.
Tracking accuracy. Zero broken attribution is the standard.

2–5+ years of SEO management at a marketing agency.

Experience with legal, local, or high-intent service industries strongly preferred.

Operates independently. You identify problems and solve them without being asked.
Data-driven decision maker who tracks qualified leads, not just traffic.
Connects every ranking and visibility metric back to case outcomes for the client.
Operations-minded. You default to documentation, process, and scalable systems.
Follows industry experts, tests new strategies, and proactively brings ideas.
Direct communicator. You say what needs to be said, when it needs to be said.




How We Work

Our core values aren't posters on a wall — they guide every decision we make.

Never Settle — We chase mastery, not perfection. Always hungry, always improving.
We Give a Damn — We show up, care deeply, and own outcomes for clients and teammates.
Courageous Communication — Truth early, respect always. We don't hide problems or avoid tough conversations.

About the job

About The Role

This position owns the day-to-day execution and optimization of performance campaigns across paid social and digital advertising platforms. Campaign Management

Work with the BI Lead to validate conversion tracking and ensure FTD attribution is accurate across all platforms.


Reporting


Report on paid media performance weekly: FTDs, CPA, CTR, ROAS, and spend pacing by platform and campaign.
Surface insights proactively anomalies, trends, and opportunities without waiting to be asked.


Requirements


2–4 years of hands-on experience managing paid social campaigns, ideally in a B2C or performance-focused environment.
Direct, working experience with at least two of the following platforms: Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, Snapchat Ads, Reddit Ads.
Understanding of core campaign mechanics: campaign structures, audience targeting, bidding strategies, and creative formats per platform.
Basic analytical skills: able to read performance data, identify patterns, and translate them into optimization actions.

Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift and speed matters.

description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

Drivers Brand Connection team is in charge of building the campaigns and platforms to connect with Drivers and help them to find in DiDi their best partner to grow — not just their income, but their story.

Having Drivers who feel proud, connected, and represented is the cornerstone of our business, and from our team we make sure we're telling their stories the right way, at the right time, across every market we serve.

We are looking for an intern who is resourceful and organized. A true team player who is proactive and not afraid of taking on challenges.

You will be interacting with stakeholders across LATAM from different areas, enriching your knowledge of the business and opening possibilities to understand how a fast-paced company works.

In this role, you'll be...


 Support the coordination and execution of driver marketing campaigns across Argentina, Mexico, and Colombia.
 Help prepare reports, decks, and dashboards for internal stakeholders and leadership reviews.
 Monitor social listening and sentiment tools, flagging relevant trends and emerging topics.
 Coordinate with agencies and internal teams (Design, Social Media, Media) to track deliverables and deadlines.
 Support content organization, campaign documentation, and asset management.
 Assist with research and benchmarking to inform new initiatives.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


Currently enrolled students who have the capacity to intern for a duration of 1 to 2 years.
Interest to grow a career on Business, Marketing or Communication.
Strong communication and presentation skills.
Excitement to generate marketing actions that impact Driver’s lives and our business. 
Positive hands-on attitude and willingness to find creative solutions to everyday challenges.
Team spirit with a structured mind to develop multiple tasks in parallel.
Data-driven mindset to ensure results evaluation.
Fluent in English.



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

About The Hershey Company

The Hershey Company (NYSE: HSY) es una empresa líder en la industria de snacks, reconocida por crear más momentos de felicidad a través de sus marcas icónicas. Con un sólido portafolio de chocolates, confitería y snacks salados, Hershey deleita a millones de consumidores cada día. Nuestras marcas incluyen Hershey’s, Reese’s, KitKat®, Dots Pretzels, Lesser Evil, Jolly Rancher, Twizzlers, Ice Breakers y muchas más.

En Hershey estamos comprometidos con generar un impacto positivo en las comunidades donde vivimos, trabajamos y hacemos negocios. Este compromiso comenzó con nuestro fundador, Milton Hershey, y continúa siendo parte fundamental de nuestra identidad.

Guiados por nuestra propuesta de valor al empleado, Lead Today. Create Tomorrow, empoderamos a nuestra gente para generar impacto hoy y construir el futuro. Nuestra mentalidad One Hershey une equipos de distintas funciones, geografías y negocios para trabajar con agilidad, colaboración y un propósito compartido.

¿Cómo encajarás en el panorama general?

Como Especialista de Marketing de Canal (Trade Marketing), serás responsable de impulsar la generación de demanda y la conexión con los shoppers mediante estrategias rentables y sostenibles en el punto de venta. Trabajarás de manera cercana con los equipos de Marketing, Ventas y Consumer & Shopper Insights para convertir información y análisis en acciones que fortalezcan la ejecución de nuestras marcas y aceleren el crecimiento del negocio.

¿Qué harás?


 Implementar estrategias de canal y cliente a través del desarrollo y ejecución de materiales y activaciones de punto de venta.
 Analizar indicadores clave de negocio como Sell In y Sell Out utilizando fuentes internas y externas de información.
 Desarrollar recomendaciones y rutas de mercado específicas por cliente para incrementar el desplazamiento de producto.
 Colaborar con equipos internos, agencias, proveedores y clientes para asegurar una ejecución impecable de las estrategias.

About the job

Why WWT?

At World Wide Technology, we work together to make a new world happen. Our important work benefits our clients and partners as much as it does our people and communities across the globe. WWT is dedicated to achieving its mission of creating a profitable growth company that is also a Great Place to Work for All. We achieve this through our world-class culture, generous benefits and by delivering cutting-edge technology solutions for our clients.

Founded in 1990, WWT is a global technology solutions provider leading the AI and Digital Revolution. WWT combines the power of strategy, execution and partnership to accelerate digital transformational outcomes for organizations around the globe. Through its Advanced Technology Center, a collaborative ecosystem of the world's most advanced hardware and software solutions, WWT helps clients and partners conceptualize, test and validate innovative technology solutions for the best business outcomes and then deploys them at scale through its global warehousing, distribution and integration capabilities.

With over 12,000 employees across WWT and Softchoice and more than 60 locations around the world, WWT's culture, built on a set of core values and established leadership philosophies, has been recognized 14 years in a row by Fortune and Great Place to Work® for its unique blend of determination, innovation and creating a great place to work for all.

Want to work with highly motivated individuals on high-performance teams? Join WWT today!

Roles Overview: 

The Business Product Analyst - Sales Products supports the delivery and adoption of digital sales tools used across the revenue lifecycle. This role works closely with Business Product Managers and cross‑functional partners to ensure sales capabilities are accurate, usable, and ready for seller adoption. The role focuses on testing product outputs, validating seller workflows, tracking adoption, and capturing structured feedback—helping translate product vision into reliable, in‑flow capabilities that sellers trust and use every day.

Core Accountability:

Accountable for executing defined product validation and adoption activities to ensure sales products meet established quality, usability, and release‑readiness standards, supporting successful rollout and sustained seller adoption in partnership with the Product Manager.

Why This Role Matters:

This role plays a critical part in transitioning new sales capabilities from concept to durable, scalable business impact. By validating product outputs, testing seller workflows, and supporting adoption, the Product Analyst helps ensure tools improve seller productivity, decision quality, and execution effectiveness—directly supporting revenue growth and improved customer outcomes.

What will you be doing?

Requirements & Intent Definition Support


Support the definition and documentation of business requirements for sales products 
Help define acceptance criteria to validate system behavior, workflow integration, and readiness 
Frame and document problems to be solved based on seller needs and workflow gaps, rather than prescribing solutions 


Product Output & Quality Validation

Seller Workflow Testing & Validation

Adoption & Rollout Support


Track adoption, usage, and readiness metrics for pilots and releases 
Support pilot execution, phased rollouts, and enablement activities 
Capture structured seller feedback and summarize insights for the product team 


Product & Change Execution Support


Maintain testing, project, and change management plans, QA logs, and release‑readiness checklists 
Log risks, issues, and dependencies identified during testing and rollout 
Support development of training materials, FAQs, and workflow documentation 


,

description:
About the job

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with a wide range of flexible payment options designed to give customers more choice, accessibility, and a smarter overall experience. We're not just transforming payments; we're redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we're building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you're excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a curious, driven, and thoughtful Product Intern to join our Payments & Fees team. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

If you want to truly understand how fintech works, there's no better place to start than payments — and no better seat than product. The Payments & Fees team sits at the intersection of technology, data, and business, working with payment processors, payment method providers, and cross-functional partners across the company. As a product intern here, you won't be watching from the sidelines. You'll be in the room (or the channel) where decisions get made, picking up context fast and contributing to a team that moves quickly and takes its craft seriously.

You'll support the product manager across a high-throughput environment: helping keep the backlog organized, digging into data to understand payment flows, and working alongside an efficient and technically sharp engineering team, as well as Design and Data teams. Product management is one of those rare roles where no two days look the same — you're constantly context-switching between technical conversations, business problems, and user needs, and that's exactly what makes it exciting.

What You'll Do:

Ticket Management & Product Support


Assist the product manager in drafting, organizing, and tracking tickets for changes and improvements to the payments service. Help ensure work is well-documented, properly prioritized, and moving through the backlog. Follow up on status and surface blockers when needed.


Context Gathering & Stakeholder Support


Help the product manager stay on top of inputs from multiple stakeholders by gathering background context, summarizing key information, and preparing materials ahead of provider meetings. Respond to routine internal questions by pulling the right information from available resources.


Payment Workflow Analysis


Learn and apply SQL to query payment data and support the creation and maintenance of dashboards that track payment performance, processing failures, and operational health. Help flag anomalies in payment flows and assist in assembling data for reviews and investigations.


Documentation & Process Tracking


Maintain clear internal documentation for payment flows, fee structures, and operational processes. Help keep cross-functional teams aligned with concise, well-structured written updates.


Agile Meetings


Participate in agile meetings and collaborate with engineering, operations, compliance, and support teams. One of the most valuable things a product manager does is serve as a bridge between tech and the business — translating technical challenges into clear language and business needs into actionable requirements. You'll get hands-on experience doing exactly that.


What We Look For:


Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, or a related field
A genuine interest in payments, fintech, and how complex financial systems work under the hood
Natural curiosity and a logical mindset — you enjoy working through problems, aren't afraid to ask questions, and get satisfaction from figuring things out
Strong attention to detail — you notice when something's off and follow through until it's resolved
Comfort working with data and a willingness to learn SQL; prior experience is a plus but not required
Effective written and verbal communication — you can summarize a complex topic clearly and ask the right questions to fill in gaps
Prior experience in internships, projects, or extracurriculars related to product, fintech, data analysis, or startups is a plus — but we hire for potential, not just pedigree.
Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.


About You:


You have relentlessly high standards — many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You're not bound by convention — your success and much of the fun lies in developing new ways to do things.
You need action — speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust — you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
You have backbone; disagree, then commit — you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
You deliver results — you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.


What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Compensation: The salary for the Product Intern is $800 USD Gross as an independent contractor.

description:
About the job

Role: Associate, Market Planning & Operations (MP&O) – LATAM Pricing & Yield

Location: São Paulo, Brazil , Mexico

Hiring Manager: Matias Apartin, Sr. Manager, MP&O (LATAM – Pricing & Yield)

The role focuses on supporting LATAM Ads Sales through commercial pricing, yield management, deal support, pricing operations, rate cards, NPP, SVA, forecasting, reporting, and cross-functional business analysis.

The ideal profile has experience in pricing/revenue management, advertising or media operations, sales operations, ad tech/programmatic, and strong Excel/Google Sheets/Tableau skills. Portuguese and English are required, with Spanish being a plus.

If this opportunity aligns with your background and interests, I’d be happy to share the complete job details and discuss next steps.




Associate, MP&O (LATAM - Pricing & Yield)

Location: São Paulo, Brazil — LATAM role (Brazil, Mexico, and other LATAM markets)

Hiring Manager: Matias Apartin, Sr. Manager, MP&O (LATAM - Pricing & Yield)

Researcher and Recruiter: TBD




Context on Position

Netflix is seeking to hire an Associate, MP&O (LATAM - Pricing & Yield) based in São Paulo to

support Ads Sales across LATAM, including Brazil, Mexico, and other markets.

This person supports LATAM commercial pricing and runs day-to-day pricing and yield

operations: inquiries, deal support, rate cards, deal tracking, approvals, system records,

reconciliations, analysis, and reporting. The work keeps Sales moving quickly while keeping

pricing, NPP, SVA (Service Value Added), and agency terms accurate across files and systems.

The role reports to Matias Apartin and works closely with LATAM Ads Sales, the Manager of

Pricing & Incentives, Sales Operations, Finance, Revenue Accounting, Measurement, Legal,

Product, and regional / global MP&O partners.




Activities include

Commercial support and analysis

● Support LATAM commercial pricing for agency and brand development

● Answer day-to-day pricing inquiries, ad hoc pricing requests, and deal-negotiation

support across LATAM

● Support deal approvals and business exceptions so pricing and deal terms follow policy

● Analyze business drivers, yield KPIs, eCPM vs floors, cash vs SVA, and incentive

utilization

● Build templates, NPP calculators / models, and dashboards for pricing, forecasting, and

inventory

● Generate supply and demand reporting and support ad hoc requests

● Support Upfronts, NPP accelerators, custom deals, and agreed floors / bands

● Create stakeholder decks and training on pricing tools and policy

Pricing operations

● Update LATAM rate card spreadsheets, keep links and tabs current, reconcile local CPM

tables against the global open rate card, and surface changes for visibility

● Maintain package files, including CPM rows, package details, SVA references, and

Sales-facing source links




● Update package trackers for market moments such as World Cup, Mother's Day,

Halloween, and other commercial windows, reflecting CPM discounts, SVA, and STS

components

● Update STS simulator files, validate title / slot inputs, maintain pricing-condition rows for

NAS, and coordinate when STS assumptions need visibility

● Maintain live-event pricing files, update event-specific slot and package tiers, review files

before Sales use, and keep source links current

Approvals and exceptions

● Review incoming SVA / AV requests against current guardrails, update the AV tracker,

and keep usage reporting ready for quarterly review

● Review makegood requests, check supporting delivery context, update the makegood

tracker, and document outcomes for reconciliation

● Log pro bono requests, track approvals, and include approved activity in the right

reporting file

● Update the exceptions tracker for requests outside standard rules, including AV usage

windows, minimum AV share, and makegood-related exceptions

● Review Ad Connect / NAS queues, update approval status, flag items that need

additional input, and document the outcome so Sales has a clear answer

● Keep approval guardrail documents current so recurring requests are handled

consistently

NPP and annual deal operations

● Run NPP quarterly reconciliation: pull NPP, AV, Salesforce, NAS / Ad Connect, and

deal-tracker inputs; reconcile the numbers; update working files; and share the output

● Run NPP end-of-year reconciliation: review annual quota status, identify retroactive

payment implications, update the tracker, and circulate numbers for alignment

● Update the deal tracker with negotiation status, committed amounts, benefits offered,

pricing conditions, and client-specific terms

● Maintain the agency deal tracker, update pacing / benefit status, and keep

rebate-relevant fields ready for QBR or Finance review

● Review missing or incomplete agency deals, update the reconciliation file, coordinate

gaps, and preserve process notes for future cycles

● Update operational inputs that feed deal calculation, benefits application, and

downstream tracking so calculators reflect the latest agreed terms

Systems and data hygiene

● Prepare client and agency pricing-condition rows, upload or submit them in NAS / Ad

Connect, and QA that the right rates appear for the right client / agency / deal

● Update special-rate records when annual deals, client negotiations, or agency terms

require non-standard pricing, then confirm the system reflects approved terms




● Create commitment records in CRM, update required fields, and ensure AM / CP teams

can link opportunities correctly

● Review Salesforce opportunity and commitment records, update missing fields, and flag

gaps that block deal execution or reporting

● Filter uploaded conditions, compare against the source spreadsheet, and document

corrections before Sales relies on the terms

● Keep the rate card, deal directory, benefits files, package trackers, pricing-condition files,

and system records aligned

Reporting, dashboards, and visibility

● Review the LATAM revenue dashboard, Agency QBR files, One Source, and related

trackers used in approvals, reconciliation, and team updates

● Update AV usage reporting, summarize quarterly usage, and share visibility with partner

teams

● Update makegood reporting, capture approved cases, and maintain history for future

review

● Update the reporting layer used by agency teams to review rebate projections and

local-currency performance

● Use revenue, pacing, and deal trackers to surface where commitments, benefits, or

delivery require follow-up

● Connect with Finance, FPO, Revenue Accounting, SOP, Sales, and global / regional

teams when trackers, reconciliations, pricing conditions, or dashboard numbers need

validation

Finance and payment follow-through

● Update preliminary agency rebate calculation files and align numbers with FP&A, FPO,

and Revenue Accounting

● Share invoice information with agency teams, track invoice status, and confirm invoice /

payment alignment

● Update Street Media commission calculation files and keep supporting numbers

traceable

● Track signature status, update deal-close follow-through, and keep the tracker current as

deals move from negotiation to execution

● Document cases where annual targets create retroactive payment implications, update

the reconciliation file, and share the numbers




What We're Looking For

● 3+ years of experience in Revenue Management, Pricing & Planning, Advertising

Operations, and/or Advertising Strategy, ideally in media or tech




● Strong modeling skills and comfort with large datasets in Google Sheets, Excel, Tableau,

and other visualization tools

● Comfort operating across multiple systems and source files (rate cards, deal trackers,

NAS / Ad Connect, Salesforce / CRM)

● Familiarity with programmatic advertising, auction dynamics, and/or ad tech is a plus

● Knowledge of the streaming advertising and ad tech ecosystem is highly preferred

● Portuguese and English required; Spanish is a plus

● Embodies Netflix's cultural values and is excited to work in a high-performance culture

● Strong attention to detail with an 80/20 eye toward solving problems

● Proactive and independent; thrives in a fast-paced, always-changing environment

● Strong interpersonal skills and proven ability to build successful relationships with

cross-functional stakeholders

● Excellent communication and presentation skills; ability to present complex analyses to

senior stakeholders

● Very strong project management, including handling multiple projects simultaneously

and delivering under tight timelines

description:
About the job

What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?

At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.

Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.

Position Summary

The Business Systems Analyst is the design authority for Salesforce-based solutions across Illumina’s Commercial and Services organizations. This role bridges business intent and technical execution; translating business strategy, stakeholder needs, and product roadmaps into robust, scalable solution designs that the engineering team builds and delivers.

You will work upstream of delivery; partnering with Product Owners to shape roadmaps, evaluating platform capabilities, and producing solution designs that account for Salesforce core, ServiceMax, Conga CPQ, Conga CLM, Data Cloud (Data 360), Agentforce, and enterprise integrations. You will earn influence through the quality of your designs and the trust you build with stakeholders and engineering teams alike.

This role operates within an Agile Scrum delivery model. Product Owners in Commercial and Services define business priorities and roadmaps. Software Engineers, Test Automation Engineers (TAEs), and Technical Architects execute delivery. The Business Systems Analyst connects these activities ensuring what gets built is the right solution, designed for scale, and aligned to Illumina’s technology strategy.

Your designs increasingly serve a second audience: the AI agents the engineering team uses to build. In an AI-augmented, spec-driven delivery model, a precise, testable, well-decomposed solution design is the specification that grounds reliable AI implementation, so the clarity of your designs, acceptance criteria, and data contracts now creates even more leverage. You also design the AI solutions themselves (Agentforce, Data Cloud) for evaluability, safe failure, and responsible, compliant use.

Responsibilities

Solution Design & Architecture


Own end-to-end solution design for Salesforce initiatives; from discovery through design approval. Produce technical design documents, data models, integration specifications, and architecture decision records.
Evaluate and recommend solution approaches across the Salesforce ecosystem: Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, ServiceMax, Conga CPQ, Conga CLM, Data Cloud (Data 360), Agentforce, and Experience Cloud.
Design cross-system solutions that account for integrations with middleware (SnapLogic), ERP (SAP), and other enterprise systems. Define data flows, API contracts, event-driven patterns, and error handling strategies.
Conduct fit-gap analysis for new requirements; assessing when to leverage declarative capabilities, custom development, AppExchange products, or third-party solutions.
Design solutions with security, compliance, scalability, and maintainability built in. Account for Salesforce governor limits, large data volumes, and multi-tenant architecture constraints.
Design Agentforce agent architectures; topic decomposition, action orchestration, guardrails, escalation flows, and Trust Layer configuration. Ensure AI solutions meet responsible AI standards.
Define data architecture for Data Cloud (Data 360) implementations; data model design, ingestion patterns, identity resolution strategy, and activation design.
Present solution options to stakeholders with clear tradeoff analysis; enabling confident, informed decisions.


Stakeholder Engagement & Advisory


Serve as a trusted technical advisor to Product Owners, business stakeholders, and engineering leadership. Translate business strategy into technology direction.
Partner with Product Owners to shape roadmaps; providing technical feasibility assessments, effort estimation guidance, and solution sequencing recommendations.
Collaborate with stakeholders to create prototypes, proofs of concept, and visual solution illustrations as a means of validating requirements and building shared understanding.
Evaluate the Salesforce platform roadmap (new releases, features, deprecations) and proactively advise stakeholders on opportunities and risks.
Communicate solution designs to both technical and non-technical audiences; tailoring depth, format, and language to the audience.
Build and maintain a solution architecture repository; reference architectures, design patterns, and decision logs that serve as institutional knowledge.


Delivery Enablement


Work 1-2 sprints ahead of development; ensuring solution designs are ready, validated, and decomposed into implementable user stories before they enter the sprint backlog.
Define success and acceptance criteria for user stories in collaboration with Product Owners. Provide guidance on story readiness and technical completeness.
Support backlog grooming and refinement; clarifying technical approach, identifying dependencies, and helping the team estimate with confidence.
Participate in sprint planning to ensure the team understands the solution design and can raise questions or concerns early.
Review completed work against the solution design; validating that implementations align with architectural intent. Provide design-level feedback during code and configuration reviews.
Collaborate with Test Automation Engineers to ensure solution designs are testable and that acceptance criteria are clear enough to drive test strategy.
Support release planning by identifying solution-level risks, cross-feature dependencies, and integration validation requirements.


Designing for the AI-Augmented SDLC


Produce solution designs precise and testable enough to act as the specification an AI-augmented team, and its agents, build from: clear acceptance criteria, decomposed scope, explicit data contracts, and the context the team can ground AI in.
Design AI solutions (Agentforce agents, Data Cloud) for evaluability and safe failure: guardrails, escalation, human-in-the-loop, and responsible-AI, model, and data-residency tradeoffs.
Use AI tools to accelerate design exploration, option analysis, and documentation (ADRs, diagrams) while owning the decisions and their rationale.
Account for governance of AI tooling and AI-generated assets in your designs: data boundaries for external AI tools, IP/authorship, and shadow-AI prevention for regulated data.


Experience

Required Qualifications


5+ years of experience in Salesforce solution design, architecture, or senior technical delivery roles.
Demonstrated experience designing solutions across multiple Salesforce clouds and third-party add-ons (ServiceMax, Conga CPQ/CLM, or similar).
Experience designing cross-system integrations involving middleware (SnapLogic or similar), ERP (SAP), and enterprise data platforms.
Experience working in Agile Scrum delivery models, including backlog grooming, sprint planning, and iterative delivery.
Proven ability to produce technical design artifacts;solution architecture diagrams, data models, integration specifications, and architecture decision records.
Experience with regulated environments (HIPAA, FDA, SOX) is preferred.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Technical


Deep understanding of the Salesforce platform;data model, security model, automation framework (Flows, Apex triggers), governor limits, and order of execution.
Strong knowledge of Salesforce integration patterns; REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, named credentials, and middleware orchestration.
Working knowledge of Agentforce; agent design, topic/action architecture, Prompt Builder, Agent Script, Atlas Reasoning Engine, and the Einstein Trust Layer.
Working knowledge of Data Cloud (Data 360);data streams, data model objects, identity resolution, calculated insights, and activations.
Functional understanding of ServiceMax (field service), Conga CPQ (quoting/pricing), and Conga CLM (contract lifecycle management).
Ability to design solutions considering non-functional requirements; performance, scalability, security, compliance, and maintainability.
Proficiency with solution architecture tools; diagramming (Lucidchart), documentation (Confluence), and design collaboration.
Working knowledge of designing for the AI-augmented SDLC: designs and specifications as the source of truth for human and agent delivery, designing AI solutions for evaluability and responsible use, and governance of AI tooling for regulated data.
Certifications (Preferred): Foundation & Platform - Salesforce Administrator, Platform App Builder.
Certifications (Preferred): Development & Specialization - Platform Developer I, Platform Developer II, Agentforce Specialist, Data Cloud (Data 360) Consultant.


Leadership & Communication


Design authority presence; ability to make and defend design decisions with confidence, while remaining open to input and challenge.
Exceptional ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences through visual diagrams, narratives, and demonstrations.
Strong facilitation skills; ability to lead design workshops, stakeholder alignment sessions, and tradeoff discussions to consensus.
Strategic thinking; ability to connect solution design decisions to business outcomes and long-term platform health.
Proactive and self-directed; works ahead of the team, anticipates design needs, and raises risks early.
Relationship builder; earns trust with both business stakeholders and engineering teams through consistent follow-through, transparency, and quality of work.


Education


Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or equivalent related work experience.

At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

About This Role

As a Senior Software Development Engineer on the Fraud Defense Engineering team, you will be at the forefront of protecting Audible's ecosystem — safeguarding creators, listeners, and customers from fraud and abuse across all global marketplaces. You'll design and build intelligent detection systems, investigation platforms, and automated enforcement capabilities that operate at scale. This is a high-impact role where your technical decisions directly protect the integrity of our business and the trust of millions of customers worldwide.

You'll drive the team forward — anticipating threats before they materialize, innovating on detection approaches, and leading the way to develop original, effective solutions. We'll support you with the latest technologies, tools, and systems you need to succeed.

About The Team

The Fraud Defense Engineering team sits within Audible's inSpire organization. We build the tooling, platforms, and automated systems that protect the integrity and trustworthiness of Audible's business. Our primary focus areas include:


 Creator Fraud — detecting and preventing fraudulent content and manipulation of royalty systems
 Anti-Piracy — engineering protections against unauthorized distribution and content theft
 Consumer Fraud — identifying and mitigating account abuse, payment fraud, and promotional exploitation


We are also experts in ensuring that Audible meets its data handling and customer privacy obligations across all marketplaces. Joining our team provides the unique challenge and opportunity to deliver software that benefits customers around the world.

You're in your element when you're being challenged, and you're always eager to share your ideas, take on responsibility, and keep developing at an exciting pace. Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. description:
About the job

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

As Renewals Specialist you will manage a focused portfolio of customer accounts to ensure the renewal of support contracts. You will create high renewal rates by engaging customers and channel partners, communicating contract value, and removing friction from the renewal process.

As Renewals Specialist you will work through remote engagement (telephone, email, Gainsight, and CRM workflows) and partners with Customer Success, Sales, Channel, and Operations and Support teams. You will use Salesforce data and processes to manage renewals, forecast risk, and support we are recurring revenue and retention goals for North America–based customers

Your Responsibilities


You will manage a defined portfolio of accounts with a primary focus on renewing support contracts on time and in full.
You will engage customers and channel partners ahead of contract expiration to create seamless renewal outcomes. Sending notifications of renewal expiration to customers.
You will communicate contract coverage, renewal options, timelines, and the value of continued support services.
You will ensure renewals, working toward renewal rate, churn, and forecasting Indicators set by leadership.
You will use Salesforce to manage renewal opportunities, track progress, maintain accurate contract data, receive and send customer quotes, and support forecasting activities.
You will partner with Partner Success Managers to align renewal strategies with channel partners.
You will collaborate with Sales, Channel teams, Contracts, and Operations on pricing, terms, documentation, and renewal execution.
You will provide first-line support for renewal-related inquiries, including contract scope, pricing questions, and renewal logistics.
You will identify renewal risk early and escalate to ensure leadership visibility and proactive mitigation.
You will follow established Salesforce and renewal processes to ensure data quality, compliance, and operational efficiency.
You will support our revenue retention and growth strategy by reducing renewal friction and improving the customer experience.


The Essentials - You Will Have


Bachelor's degree.


The Preferred - You Might Also Have


Minimum 1–2 years of experience in Renewals, Customer Success, Inside Sales, Sales Operations, or Contract Management (preferred).
Experience working with CRM tools such as Salesforce for opportunity management, forecasting, and reporting.
Experience supporting North America–based customers.


What We Offer

Our benefits package includes …


Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees.
Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
Employee Assistance Program
Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
On-demand digital course library for professional development... and other local benefits!


Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

About the job

Company Overview

Our client builds an all-in-one booking and park-management platform for outdoor hospitality. Campground, RV park, and glamping operators use it to manage reservations, availability, rates, payments, guest messaging, and reporting in one place. It also runs a traveler-facing marketplace that brings operators more bookings.

Many customers are small and mid-sized businesses whose busiest days depend on the software running smoothly. They choose this platform for its ease of use and for the real, hands-on support behind it.

Your Role

This role exists to keep customers successful long after onboarding ends.

You'll be the go-to contact for a portfolio of parks. You'll answer questions, solve problems, and help operators use more of the platform as their business grows. Success in this role means customers feel supported, use the product confidently, and stay with the platform year after year.

You’ll:


Serve as the main point of contact for a portfolio of active customers

description:
About the job

The mission:

We are looking for someone who will produce a measurable uplift in Baubap's acquisition and growth metrics through lifecycle management.

This role owns the communication layer of the customer lifecycle from the acquisition and growth side: from first touch and activation, through repeat usage and expansion. Unlike a traditional CRM/lifecycle role, this is not about shipping campaigns, flows or canvases — it is about connecting every lifecycle decision to a business outcome (conversion rate, new borrowers, activation rate, repeat origination, LTV) and proving, with data, what that decision was worth.

The person in this role thinks like a growth analyst first and a lifecycle operator second. They use data, experimentation and behavioral logic to decide who we talk to, with what message, through which channel, at what moment.

This is not a "send the campaign" role. It is the role that decides who we talk to, with what message, through which channel, at what moment, and then proves, with data, what that decision was worth to the business. Every communications decision needs to be provable with data — not assumed, not "it felt right." And this person doesn't run one initiative at a time: they are expected to be the owner of multiple projects in parallel, each with its own baseline, accountability, and result.

The expected outcome:

Business analysis and impact orientation


Connect every lifecycle initiative to a growth or business metric (activation, new borrowers, repeat origination, LTV) before it is designed. If an initiative cannot be tied to an outcome, it doesn't ship.
Analyze funnel and cohort data to find where the business is leaking value, and prioritize initiatives by expected economic impact, not by ease of execution.
Own the analytical read of what is working and what is not, and kill what is not — including your own initiatives.


End-to-end design and execution


Design and implement the lifecycle communication strategy end to end: journey design, copy, execution in the CRM (Braze), and coordination with paid/acquisition channels and product touchpoints where relevant.
Design, run and measure experiments (A/B tests, holdouts, sample definition, cohort comparisons) to validate what actually moves the needle, not just what looks better.
Build the channel and timing logic for acquisition/activation moments and defend it with results.


Measurement, rollout and guardrails


Every initiative starts with a baseline, an expected uplift, a defined success metric and guardrails. No initiative launches without them.
Own the full rollout: correct execution, monitoring, and attention to incidents or edge cases as they appear.
Build the dashboards needed to read your own initiatives without depending on someone else pulling the number for you.


Cross-functional work


Build standing relationships with Product, Data, Engineering and Marketing/Growth — not one-off requests, but agreed ways of working (tracking plans, review turnaround, incident response).
Be the proactive owner of your own projects: you don't wait for someone to unblock you or chase you for status. You chase dependencies, follow up, and make sure things actually happen end to end with cross-functional teams.
Make sure acquisition and lifecycle messaging tell one coherent story, aligned with Marketing/Branding and Customer Support.


Preferred Additional Qualifications and Experience:


Desired 5+ years in CRM, lifecycle communications or retention marketing; ideally in fintech, financial services, lending or high-growth B2C.
Proven experience owning initiatives that moved a hard business metric (activation, payback, repeat rate, retention, LTV), not only engagement metrics.
Experience designing and reading experiments (A/B tests, cohorts, attribution) is a must.
Hands-on knowledge of Braze (or equivalent engagement platform): segmentation, Canvas flows, personalization, reporting.
Product analytics / attribution tools (e.g. PostHog, Tenjin, or equivalent).
Comfortable building your own dashboards and pulling your own reads (SQL or BI tooling is a plus).
Figma, for lifecycle experience design.
Claude and AI tooling as daily infrastructure: analysis, copy, workflow.
Education: Industrial engineering, economics, business administration, marketing or related degrees.
Fluent in Spanish and English.

title: Customer Service Specialist – E-commerce (Remoto, Turno Tarde)
description:
About the job

¿Te apasiona resolver problemas, tienes experiencia real con Shopify y quieres ser parte de una marca internacional en pleno crecimiento?




Somos una empresa de e-commerce con sede en Estados Unidos y operaciones activas en Chile, México y España.

Estamos ampliando nuestro equipo de atención al cliente y buscamos Customer Service Specialist que cubra el turno de la tarde. Personas proactivas, con criterio, que disfruten cuidar cada interacción con el cliente y aportar ideas para mejorar el servicio.




Este es un rol clave dentro del equipo. No solo responderás mensajes: serás la voz de la marca frente a nuestros clientes en LATAM en la ventana horaria de la tarde, y trabajarás muy cerca de las áreas de operaciones y marketing.




¿Qué harás en tu día a día?

Responder correos de clientes con un tono cercano, profesional y resolutivo.

 Atender mensajes directos, comentarios y menciones en redes sociales a través de Meta Business Suite (Instagram y Facebook).

 Gestionar contracargos y disputas en Shopify Payments y PayPal, recopilando la evidencia necesaria y presentando los casos en los plazos correspondientes.

 Corroborar datos de pedidos, hacer seguimiento de envíos y coordinar soluciones con clientes desde el panel de Shopify.

 Identificar preguntas recurrentes y sugerir mejoras en plantillas de respuesta, FAQs y procesos internos.

 Detectar oportunidades para convertir consultas en ventas y aportar activamente al crecimiento del negocio.

 Reportar métricas semanales de atención (volumen, tiempos de respuesta, casos críticos).







¿Qué buscamos en ti?




Mínimo 2 años de experiencia en customer service para e-commerce.

 Experiencia comprobable trabajando con Shopify (requisito excluyente).

 Experiencia gestionando contracargos y disputas en Shopify Payments y PayPal.

 Manejo fluido de Meta Business Suite para atender comunidades activas en Instagram y Facebook.

 Español nativo con excelente redacción, ortografía y capacidad para adaptar el tono según el canal.

 Actitud proactiva: si ves algo que se puede mejorar, lo propones. No esperas instrucciones para todo.

 Orientación al detalle y capacidad de trabajo autónomo (este rol es 100% remoto y necesitas gestionarte solo/a).

 Empatía real con el cliente y paciencia para casos difíciles.

 Conexión a internet estable y equipo propio (computador funcional).

Lo que ofrecemos

Modalidad: 100% remoto. Puedes trabajar desde cualquier ubicación siempre que cumplas con el horario del puesto.

 Jornada: Part-time, 30 horas semanales.

 Horario: Lunes a viernes, de 13:00 a 19:00 hrs hora de México (CDMX). Equivalencias: 16:00 a 22:00 hrs hora de Chile (GMT-3) / 21:00 a 03:00 hrs hora de España (CEST).




 Compensación: USD 300 mensuales fijos + comisiones por ventas (sin techo).

 Fecha de inicio: Aproximadamente primera semana de octubre.

 Ambiente colaborativo, con espacio real para proponer ideas y crecer dentro de la empresa.

 Formar parte de un equipo internacional en una marca en expansión.







¿Cómo postular?

Aplica directamente aquí en LinkedIn con tu CV actualizado.

Revisamos cada postulación con atención. Si tu perfil encaja, nos contactaremos contigo en un plazo máximo de 5 días hábiles para coordinar una primera entrevista.




¡Esperamos conocerte pronto!

description:
About the job

Who We Are

CloudKitchens helps restaurateurs around the world succeed in online food delivery - our goal is to make food more affordable, higher quality and convenient for everyone.

We take underutilized properties and transform them into smart kitchens so they can better serve restaurateurs, customers and the neighborhoods they’re in. Every time we launch a new facility we create jobs in that neighborhood, and we’re proud to provide a wide range of cuisines and options for healthy food at an affordable price.

We're changing the game for restaurateurs whether they’re entrepreneurs opening their first restaurant all the way through to your favorite global quick-service restaurant chains.

About The Role

This is first and foremost an analysis and strategy role, and it sits on top of one of the most important conversion channels we have. You own the thinking behind the account: what to test, what to cut, and how to push toward the leads most likely to become customers. Because paid search drives so much of our inbound pipeline, this is a high-visibility, high-impact seat, and what you decide here shows up directly in the numbers the business watches.

Day-to-day execution largely sits with our paid marketing agency, so a big part of the job is coordinating them well: setting priorities, briefing the work, reviewing what they ship, and holding the bar on quality and pace. It is not a hands-off role, though. You should be ready to get into the account yourself when a change needs to move fast or be done right. The mission is clear: use lower-funnel conversion signals to bring in better, higher-quality leads.

You will work directly with the performance marketing lead and move fast. We lean on AI tools to work smarter, so expect them to be part of how you do the job every day.

What You'll Do


Own the analysis and strategy for the Google Ads program: what to test, what to scale, and what to cut.
Raise the account's Quality Score by improving ad relevance and landing page experience.
Own conversion tracking and feed the account lower-funnel signals, so it optimizes toward high-quality leads and not just form fills.
Coordinate our paid marketing agency: set priorities, brief the work, review what they ship, and hold the bar on quality and pace.
Dig into the data (search terms, Quality Score, lead quality) to separate what works from what is waste, and turn it into a clear plan.
Get hands-on in the account when needed: restructure ad groups, add negatives, adjust bids, fix tracking.
Use AI tools like Claude to work faster and sharper: structure and analyze data, pressure-test your hypotheses, and move from insight to decision in less time. The judgment stays yours; the tools just let you cover more ground.
Run a continuous testing agenda and report performance clearly: what changed, what it moved, and what is next.


What Success Looks Like


Within your first few months, Quality Score is trending up and high-quality leads are a bigger share of the mix.
The agency runs smoothly under you: clear priorities, fast turnarounds, and work that meets your bar.
Your reporting is the source of truth the team trusts to decide where paid search goes next.


What We Are Looking For


2+ years of hands-on Google Ads / paid search, ideally in lead generation, with results you can point to.
Advanced, near-native English, written and spoken. You will write ad copy and reports for a US audience.
Real fluency with the Google Ads account structure: match types, Smart Bidding, conversion actions, and search-terms analysis.
You are comfortable with data: you pull the numbers, read them, and turn them into a decision without hand-holding.
Strong spreadsheet skills, non-negotiable. We work in Google Sheets, and if you are not fluent with pivot tables, conditional functions, and lookups (VLOOKUP / XLOOKUP), this is not the role for you.
A bias for action and strong ownership. You move fast, document your work, and do not need to be chased.
Clear communication. You can explain a tradeoff to someone who does not live in the account.


Nice to have


Performance Max and broader Google campaign types.
Solid GA4, including conversion tracking setup and QA.
Building or iterating landing pages (we use Lovable) and improving conversion rate with tools like Microsoft Clarity.
Familiarity with B2B marketing.
Basic SQL or a data background, a plus and not a requirement.


Tools you will use 

Google Ads, GA4, Google Sheets, Lovable for landing pages, Microsoft Clarity, and Claude for scaled execution.

Why join us 


Demand for online food delivery is growing really fast! In the last 5 years, just in the US, the overall market has expanded 10X from $10B to $100B, and could expand to $500bn- $1T by 2030.
Changing the restaurant industry: You’ll be part of a team that helps restaurants succeed in online food delivery. 
Collaborative environment: You will receive support and guidance from experienced colleagues and managers, helping you to learn, grow and achieve your goals, and you’ll work closely with other teams to ensure our customer’s success.


What Else You Need To Know

This role is based in our Mexico CIty office location. As a company driven by innovation and continuous change, close collaboration is essential. We’re constantly reimagining our industry, creating new products, and refining our processes, and we do our best work together. That’s why all of our office-based teams work onsite, five days a week.

Ready to join us as we serve those who serve others?

Formarás parte del equipo de Revenue Growth Management (RGM), apoyando el análisis y ejecución de nuestra estrategia promocional y generando insights que contribuyan a mejores decisiones de negocio.

Principales responsabilidades:


Apoyar al equipo de RGM Promo en la ejecución, seguimiento y análisis del proceso promocional.
Analizar el desempeño de promociones a través de indicadores como elasticidad, uplift, ROI e inversión promocional.
Dar seguimiento a resultados reales vs. estimados, identificando desviaciones, aprendizajes y oportunidades de mejora.
Gestionar y mantener actualizadas bases de datos de clientes, productos, precios y promociones, asegurando la calidad de la información.
Elaborar cierres mensuales, reportes y análisis de desempeño por categoría.
Dar seguimiento a la correcta implementación de precios y promociones aprobadas.
Transformar datos en insights y recomendaciones que apoyen la toma de decisiones del equipo de RGM.
Participar en proyectos de mejora continua y optimización de la estrategia promocional.
Colaborar con diferentes áreas del negocio para desarrollar una visión integral de cómo las decisiones de precio y promoción impactan el crecimiento y la rentabilidad.



¿Qué buscamos?


Estudiantes de últimos semestres de Economía, Actuaría, Ingeniería Industrial, Finanzas, Business Analytics, Administración o carreras afines, con interés en desarrollar una carrera en áreas comerciales y analíticas.
Perfil analítico y numérico, con capacidad para trabajar con información, identificar tendencias y generar conclusiones.
Manejo de Excel intermedio-avanzado.
Inglés intermedio-avanzado.
Pensamiento estructurado, atención al detalle y orientación a resultados.
Curiosidad por entender el negocio y cómo las decisiones de precio y promoción impactan las ventas y rentabilidad.
Capacidad de aprendizaje, iniciativa y disposición para trabajar de manera colaborativa.



Será un plus contar con conocimientos de Power BI, SQL, herramientas de visualización de datos o estadística aplicada.

No es necesario contar con experiencia previa en RGM: buscamos personas con potencial, curiosidad y ganas de desarrollar habilidades analíticas y comerciales.

No Relocation support available

Our diverse portfolio includes iconic and mouth-watering global brands such as Trident, Oreo, Philadelphia, and local jewels like Clorets and Bubbaloo. We are leaders in the making of cream cheese, powdered beverages and confections—in fact, we make seven out of every 10 chewing gums consumed by Mexicans. description:

Responsibilities
Team Intro
The commerce industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become a hotly contested space amongst leading Internet companies, and its future growth cannot be underestimated.

With millions of loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better commerce experience to our users. We are looking for passionate and talented people to join our operations team, together we can build an commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure and intuitive for our users.

We are looking for a passionate and strategic Creator Incubation Manager (Electronics Category) to join our team. You will be responsible for nurturing and elevating high-potential e-commerce creators, helping them master content creation techniques to drive their GMV growth. Rather than general creator recruitment, your core focus will be matching the right creators with curated category product assortments, co-creating high-impact content to achieve explosive sales growth. Additionally, you will provide hands-on training for agency and individual livestream hosts, guiding them on livestream tools, scripts, and post-session data reviews. A key part of your role will be translating data into actionable strategies and successfully persuading creators to adopt them for continuous performance improvement.

Responsibilities:
- Empower and incubate high-potential e-commerce creators by guiding them on e-commerce content production techniques, increasing their posting frequency and content quality, and ultimately driving their GMV growth.
- Deeply understand curated product assortments within focus categories and identify the most suitable creators for them. Co-create compelling content with these creators to achieve massive sales breakthroughs that outpace the broader market.
- Provide comprehensive training and guidance for agency hosts and individual livestreamers. Help them master livestreaming tools, refine and optimize their on-camera scripts (talk tracks), and encourage higher streaming frequency to maximize the ROI of each session.
- Conduct in-depth post-livestream data reviews with creators. Leverage data analysis to formulate highly actionable strategies, successfully persuade hosts/creators to adopt these recommendations, and track execution to ensure improved results.
- Ensure creators maintain high-quality content standards and adhere to platform guidelines to build a healthy and sustainable e-commerce ecosystem.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the distinct ability to translate data into actionable plans and successfully persuade creators/hosts to execute them.
- Deep understanding of e-commerce content (short video & livestreaming) and the ability to co-create content strategies that perfectly match specific product assortments.
- Service-oriented mindset, patience, and excellent communication skills to deeply coach, train, and build trust with creators and agency hosts.

Preferred Qualifications:
- 3+ years of experience in e-commerce operations, creator incubation, or livestreaming management.
- Proven track record of delivering comprehensive livestream training, optimizing livestream scripts, and driving measurable GMV growth for creators or brands.
