title: Customer Marketing Sr. Lead
description:
About the job

El Customer Marketing Sr. Lead es el responsable de diseñar y ejecutar la estrategia de marketing para distintas marcas de la empresa en todos los ambientes de retail que atiende la unidad de negocio: department stores, specialty, autoservicio, eCommerce, clubs, distribuidores y cuentas especializadas. La posición actúa como el puente entre la estrategia de marca y la ejecución en punto de venta, proveyendo a cada KAM las herramientas, propuestas de activación, análisis de categoría y planes de cliente que necesita para competir y ganar en su canal.

A diferencia de un rol de marketing corporativo, este puesto vive en la intersección comercial: entiende el negocio de cada cuenta, habla el idioma del comprador y del KAM, y traduce los assets de marca en soluciones concretas que generan sell-out. Da servicio transversal a todo el equipo de la unidad de negocio — incluyendo los KAMs de Departamentales, Mass, eComm, Walmart & Sam's Club, Costco y distribuidores — asegurando consistencia de mensaje, diferenciación por canal y rentabilidad de las inversiones de trade.




PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILIDADES

 30% – Estrategia de Canal y Go-to-Market

• Desarrollar y mantener actualizado el plan de Go-to-Market (GTM) por ambiente de retail: propuesta de valor, surtido recomendado, estrategia de precio (índice MSRP por canal) y mecánica de activación diferenciada.

• Diseñar la arquitectura de portafolio por canal en coordinación con el equipo: qué SKUs van a cada ambiente, con qué posicionamiento y a qué precio al consumidor.

• Traducir la estrategia de marca en iniciativas de activación relevantes para cada canal y tipo de cuenta, adaptando el mensaje al shopper de cada ambiente (premium en department, volumen en clubs, conveniencia en autoservicio, descubrimiento en specialty).

• Construir y actualizar el análisis de categoría (coolers, beverage y camping) por canal: tamaño, participación de mercado, benchmarks vs. competencia (YETI, Stanley, Igloo) y oportunidades de ganancia.

• Definir y dar seguimiento a los KPIs de marketing al canal: sell-out, share of shelf, ROI de activaciones, distribución numérica y ponderada, y cumplimiento del Perfect Store.







 25% – Activación & Comercialización 

• Diseñar el calendario anual de activaciones por canal y por cuenta, alineado a temporalidades clave (Buen Fin, Navidad, Día del Padre, Verano, regreso a clases) y a las ventanas de catalogación de cada retailer.

• Liderar la ejecución de lanzamientos de producto en el canal junto con el equipo de Perfect Store: propuesta de surtido, materiales de punto de venta (POP), displays, planogramas y acciones de sell-in y sell-out coordinadas con los KAMs.

• Desarrollar propuestas de activación específicas para cuentas nuevas (en particular, para el KAM Mass & New Accounts al aperturar cuentas como Innova Sport, Martí, cadenas de gimnasios y nuevo retail), incluyendo materiales de presentación y kits de entrada.

• Coordinar con el equipo de Perfect Store la implementación de los estándares de exhibición en punto de venta para cada ambiente de retail.

• Asegurar la correcta producción y entrega oportuna de materiales de trade (POP, exhibidores, material digital, señalética) en coordinación con proveedores y el equipo de marketing corporativo.

• Liderar activaciones especiales en piso de venta: demostraciones de producto, sampling, eventos en tienda y activaciones en plataformas digitales de los retailers (Walmart Connect, Liverpool Online, etc.).




 25% – Gestión de P&L de Canal y Presupuesto de Trade

• Construir y dar seguimiento al P&L de marketing por canal y por cuenta clave: inversión de trade (ITN), retorno sobre la inversión y contribución marginal de las activaciones.

• Administrar el presupuesto de Customer Marketing de la unidad de negocio, asegurando eficiencia en la asignación de recursos entre canales y entre marcas.

• Analizar el ROI de cada activación y proporcionar recomendaciones al equipo para optimizar la inversión en los canales y cuentas con mayor retorno.

• Colaborar con el área de RGM en la construcción del forecast de inversión de trade por canal y en la revisión mensual de la ejecución vs. presupuesto.

• Asegurar que toda inversión de trade cumpla con las condiciones pactadas en los acuerdos comerciales de cada cuenta y que esté respaldada con evidencia de ejecución.




 20% – Soporte Comercial y Colaboración con el Equipo de la unidad de negocio

• Proveer a cada KAM de O&R los materiales, análisis y argumentos de venta que necesita para sus negociaciones: decks de categoría, propuestas de activación, estudios de shopper, análisis de sell-out y benchmarks competitivos.

• Colaborar estrechamente con los equipos de Walmart, Sam's Club, Autoservicios, eCommerce, Specialty, Costco y distribuidores para asegurar consistencia de las activaciones en esos canales, sin duplicar inversión ni generar conflictos de precio o surtido.

• Participar en los business reviews de las cuentas clave como soporte analítico y de propuesta de activación, aportando perspectiva de marketing al canal.

• Coordinar con el equipo de eCommerce las activaciones digitales en Amazon MX, Mercado Libre y tiendas en línea de los retailers, asegurando coherencia con la estrategia de canal físico.

• Fungir como punto de contacto con el equipo de Marketing Local, Marketing Regional y Perfect Store para garantizar que los materiales y lineamientos globales se adapten correctamente al mercado mexicano.




IMPACTO AL NEGOCIO

Nivel de autonomía

Alto. El Customer Marketing Manager toma decisiones independientes sobre la priorización de activaciones, el diseño de propuestas de canal y la asignación del presupuesto de trade dentro de los lineamientos aprobados. Escala al Senior Manager Specialty & Department Stores (línea sólida) en decisiones de inversión por encima del presupuesto autorizado, y al Sr Manager Customer Marketing (línea punteada) en temas de proceso, estándares de herramientas y alineación con la estrategia de Customer Marketing de la organización.




Relaciones clave

• Internas:  Senior Manager Specialty & Department Stores, KAM Dept & Specialty, KAM Mass & New Accounts, KAM eComm, KAM WM/Sam's, KAM Costco, KAE Distribuidores, Sr Manager Customer Marketing, equipo de RGM, Supply Chain, Perfect Store y Marketing Local y Regional.

• Externas:  Compradores de marketing y equipos de colaboración comercial de Liverpool, Palacio de Hierro, Walmart, Sam's Club, Costco, Chedraui, Innova Sport, Martí y plataformas de eCommerce. Proveedores de material POP y producción de activaciones.

Complejidad en resolución de problemas

Alta. El rol opera simultáneamente en múltiples canales con dinámicas distintas — desde el proceso de catalogación anual de Liverpool hasta la apertura de una cuenta nueva en un gimnasio — y debe mantener coherencia de marca y pricing sin generar conflictos entre ambientes. Requiere capacidad de priorizar en un entorno de alta demanda interna, donde varios KAMs con necesidades urgentes compiten por el mismo recurso de marketing.

Habilidades interpersonales

El rol exige comunicación ejecutiva fluida en español e inglés, capacidad de influencia sin autoridad formal (da servicio a KAMs que no le reportan directamente), escucha activa para entender las necesidades de cada canal y habilidad para gestionar múltiples stakeholders internos y externos con prioridades distintas. La persona debe ser percibida por el equipo comercial como un aliado estratégico, no como un proveedor interno de materiales.




REQUISITOS MÍNIMOS

Educación

• Licenciatura terminada en Mercadotecnia, Administración de Empresas, Comunicación, Ingeniería Industrial o afín.

• Maestría en Administración de Empresas (MBA), Marketing Estratégico o equivalente — deseable.

Experiencia

• Mínimo 5 años de experiencia en Customer Marketing, trade marketing o gestión de categoría en empresas de consumo masivo o equipamiento deportivo/outdoor.

• Experiencia gestionando activaciones en múltiples canales simultáneamente: departamental, autoservicio, specialty y/o eCommerce — requerida.

• Historial en categorías de consumo relacionadas: outdoor, deportes, hogar, beverage, pequeños electrodomésticos o estilo de vida activo — preferente.

• Experiencia coordinando equipos comerciales y de marketing sin relación de reporte directo (influencia transversal) — valorable.

• Experiencia en construcción de P&L de canal y administración de presupuesto de trade investment (ITN) — requerida.

• Exposición a herramientas de Perfect Store, planogramas y métricas de ejecución en punto de venta — deseable.

Competencias

• Orientación comercial — comprende el negocio del KAM, piensa en términos de sell-out, share y rentabilidad, no solo en términos de campaña o visibilidad de marca.

• Fuerte capacidad analítica — construcción de análisis de categoría, lectura de datos de Nielsen/Kantar/GS1, interpretación de sell-out por SKU y canal, y construcción de argumentos basados en datos.

• Identificar y desarrollar oportunidades de White Space, evaluando nuevas categorías, ocasiones de consumo, canales, clientes y modelos de comercialización que permitan ampliar el mercado direccionable en México.

• Construir el business case de nuevas oportunidades de crecimiento, dimensionando potencial de mercado, shopper objetivo, propuesta de valor, portafolio, pricing, inversión requerida, rentabilidad y plan de entrada.

• Gestión de proyectos — manejo simultáneo de múltiples activaciones, cuentas y canales, con capacidad de priorizar sin perder detalle de ejecución.

• Experiencia demostrable desarrollando al menos una nueva categoría, canal, cliente, plataforma comercial o modelo de negocio desde su conceptualización hasta su ejecución y medición de resultados — altamente deseable.

• Comunicación ejecutiva — presentaciones sólidas ante compradores, liderazgo interno y equipos regionales, en español e inglés.

• Colaboración y servicio interno — genuinamente orientado a empoderar al equipo comercial; entiende que su éxito se mide por el crecimiento rentable que logra habilitar junto con los KAMs, convirtiendo oportunidades de mercado en resultados comerciales

• Adaptabilidad — cómodo operando en una estructura nueva con procesos en construcción, con capacidad de crear herramientas y metodologías donde hoy no existen.




Requisitos técnicos




• Excel avanzado — modelos de P&L de canal, análisis de sell-out, construcción de dashboards de KPIs y simuladores de ROI de activación.

• PowerPoint / herramientas de presentación — capacidad de producir decks de categoría y propuestas de activación de calidad ejecutiva de forma autónoma.

• Digital & AI mindset — utiliza datos, automatización e inteligencia artificial para acelerar análisis, identificar oportunidades, elevar la calidad de las decisiones y reducir trabajo manual

• Conocimiento de herramientas de análisis de categoría: Nielsen, Kantar, GS1, ANTAD o equivalentes — deseable.

• Experiencia con plataformas de eCommerce de retailers (Walmart Connect, Liverpool Online, Amazon Ads) — valorable.

• Dominio de inglés avanzado — mínimo B2 comprobable (coordinación con equipos regionales y globales , lectura de materiales de marca en inglés).




Otros requisitos

• Disponibilidad para visitas de campo periódicas a punto de venta y a cuentas clave para validar ejecución.

• Disponibilidad para participar en showrooms, eventos de la industria y reuniones con cuentas en horarios extendidos cuando la operación lo requiera.

• Licencia de conducir vigente.

description:
About the job

🚀 Manager de Ingeniería de Software | Presencial | Inglés B2+.




¿Te apasiona liderar equipos de ingeniería de alto desempeño y aprovechar el poder de la Inteligencia Artificial para acelerar el desarrollo de software? Esta oportunidad puede ser para ti.

Nuestro cliente es una compañía global líder en tecnología legal impulsada por IA, eDiscovery, informática forense digital, gobierno de la información y recuperación de datos. Sus soluciones ayudan a firmas legales, corporaciones y entidades gubernamentales a enfrentar desafíos complejos relacionados con litigios, cumplimiento normativo, investigaciones y gestión de información.




📌 Sobre el cargo.

Buscamos un Manager de Ingeniería de Software con un enfoque centrado en las personas, capaz de desarrollar equipos de alto rendimiento combinando liderazgo, criterio técnico sólido y prácticas modernas de desarrollo potenciadas por IA.

Esta posición combina liderazgo y profundidad técnica, manteniéndote lo suficientemente cerca del código para participar en revisiones de diseño y arquitectura, al tiempo que impulsas el crecimiento del equipo y la ejecución de proyectos estratégicos.




🎯 Responsabilidades principales.

✅ Liderar la planificación, priorización y entrega de proyectos junto con equipos de Producto.

✅ Garantizar el cumplimiento de cronogramas y compromisos de negocio.

✅ Remover bloqueos que puedan afectar la productividad y la velocidad de entrega.

✅ Asegurar estándares de calidad mediante revisiones de diseño y código.

✅ Definir buenas prácticas para la adopción y validación de código generado con herramientas de IA.

✅ Brindar mentoría, coaching y retroalimentación continua al equipo de ingeniería.

✅ Participar en procesos de contratación e integración de nuevos miembros del equipo.

✅ Impulsar la mejora continua de procesos y prácticas de desarrollo.

✅ Requisitos

🔹 6 años de experiencia en desarrollo de software.

🔹 3 años liderando, mentorando o gestionando equipos técnicos.

🔹 Experiencia entregando productos en entornos que utilizan herramientas de IA para el desarrollo de software.

🔹 Capacidad demostrada para gestionar cronogramas y asumir responsabilidad sobre los resultados.

🔹 Excelentes habilidades de comunicación verbal y escrita.

🔹 Experiencia colaborando con equipos distribuidos en diferentes zonas horarias.

🔹 Conocimiento de entornos .NET / C# y PostgreSQL es deseable.

🔹 Nivel de inglés B2+ obligatorio.




🌟 Lo que valoramos

Buscamos líderes que compartan una cultura basada en:

🔹 El cliente siempre es la prioridad.

🔹 Mejora continua cada día.

🔹 Responsabilidad sobre los resultados.

🔹 Trabajo colaborativo para alcanzar objetivos comunes.

📍 Modalidad

🏢 Presencial (Onsite).

📅 Lunes a viernes.

Si cuentas con experiencia liderando equipos de ingeniería, disfrutas desarrollando talento y te apasiona la innovación tecnológica con IA, nos encantaría conocerte.

description:
About the job

Accounting Support Specialist (US Accounting, English) | Remote, Mexico | Full Time

Join BQE Software as an Accounting Support Specialist! We're looking for an experienced accountant who wants to apply their expertise in a software environment. You'll be the go-to accounting resource for our support team and help shape how our product handles accounting for thousands of firms.




About BQE Software

 BQE Software empowers architects, engineers, and professional services firms with innovative firm management solutions. Our award-winning products, including BQE CORE®, BQE BillQuick®, BQE ArchiOffice®, and BQE EngineerOffice®, help firms streamline time tracking, billing, project management, and accounting. With 400,000+ users worldwide, BQE is a trusted partner for industry-leading professionals.




The Role

 This is a senior-level support role for an accounting professional. You'll lead accounting-related issues across our support team, help agents resolve complex questions, and work closely with our Product team to make sure accounting issues are understood and addressed. You'll also handle escalated tickets and phone calls with customers, who are primarily small to mid-sized professional services firms.

You do not need prior software support experience. We're looking for strong, practical accounting knowledge and the ability to explain accounting concepts clearly. We'll teach you our products.




What You'll Do

Serve as the team's lead resource for accounting-related issues and support agents with complex questions.
Monitor accounting tickets for SLA compliance and ensure timely, well-documented escalations.
Partner with Product to ensure escalated issues are clearly understood from an accounting perspective.
Identify product deficiencies and advocate for improvements based on customer impact and accounting best practices.
Review proposed data corrections to ensure fixes are accurate from an accounting perspective.
Handle escalated tickets and customer phone calls, and support the queue as needed.
Troubleshoot accounting issues such as GL discrepancies, reconciliations, AR/AP aging, and revenue recognition.
Partner with the support trainer to develop and validate accounting training content.
Provide ticket-level coaching and feedback to agents on accounting issues.
Create and improve internal knowledge base and Help Center content on accounting topics.
Accurately document customer interactions and resolutions in our ticketing system.




What We're Looking For

Bachelor's degree in Accounting (Contador Público) or a related field.
4+ years of accounting experience.
Working knowledge of US accounting practices (US GAAP) gained by working with US companies or clients.
Solid understanding of:
cash and accrual basis accounting
AR/AP
bank reconciliations
journal entries
closing periods
financial statements
Ability to explain accounting concepts clearly to non-accountants.
Advanced English (C1 or higher), written and verbal, with the ability to handle customer phone calls.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Comfortable working independently and collaborating with US-based teams.




Preferred Skills and Experience

Experience with QuickBooks Online or QuickBooks Desktop.
Experience with accounting for professional services firms, including project billing, WIP, or retainers.
Background in software, SaaS, or customer-facing accounting roles.
Familiarity with support or CRM tools such as Zendesk or Salesforce.




What We Are NOT Requiring

CPA certification.
Prior software support experience.
Expert knowledge of ASC 606 or corporate-level accounting.
Tax expertise.




Success in the First 90 Days

Learn BQE CORE's accounting functionality and our escalation workflow.
Independently resolve escalated accounting tickets and calls.
Serve as an accounting resource for the support team and support trainer.
Take ownership of SLA monitoring for accounting tickets.
Begin identifying product improvement opportunities and bringing them to Product.




Schedule

 Monday to Friday, 8-hour daytime shift aligned with US Pacific Time (start between 6:00 and 8:00 AM PT).




Perks and Benefits

100% remote work.
Standard medical coverage for the employee, fully paid by BQE.
Laptop provided, plus additional equipment as needed.
Career growth: training, mentorship, and advancement within a growing company.
Collaborative culture: work with supportive peers and innovative product teams.
Global impact: contribute to products trusted by over 400,000 professionals worldwide.
Work-life balance: a focus on employee well-being.




Application Process

 Selected candidates will be invited to complete a short online assessment, followed by an accounting exercise and a mock customer call during the interview process.




Why Join BQE?

 At BQE, you'll be part of a customer-first, innovation-driven team. If you're an accountant who enjoys solving problems and explaining complex topics, we'd love to hear from you.

About the job

As a member of our operations team, you will be accountable for driving revenue by ensuring that Scale AI meets customer commitments in a timely manner while maintaining the highest quality standards. You will manage our supply operation funnel by building and running solutions, tools, and processes by working with a cross-functional team including Customer Operations, Product Operations, Product Managers, and many others.

You will be solving problems no one has solved before, and you will need to be relentless in driving stellar results, running pilots, tests, and experiments. You’ll come up with creative solutions to bottlenecks. The blend of operations and ownership of our most important outcomes make this a unique and exciting role at the heart of Scale’s daily operations.The ideal candidate is scrappy, analytical, empathetic, outcome focused, and above all someone who drives and inspires results.

You will:


Build and drive some of our most critical operational processes
Own the day-to-day delivery of customer commitments
Create an effective feedback loop between the front line, product, strategy, and customers
Collaborate with stakeholders to improve processes for new and existing customers 


Ideally you'd have:


Advanced English skills
Industry experience (+2) in an operational role and/or a top-tier consulting firm
An undergraduate degree with an analytics heavy major (e.g., Engineering or Economics) and/or a graduate degree in Engineering, Economics, or Business
An action-oriented mindset that balances creative problem solving with the scrappiness to ultimately deliver results
Analytical, planning, and process improvement capability
Experience with reading SQL, or have demonstrated analytical skills


PLEASE NOTE: Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants.

About Us:

At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, Ernst & Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force. description:
About the job

Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are… 

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

The Job 

The Manager of Technology Strategic Sourcing (TSS) will collaborate with our global internal clients across the global WBD Technology organizations to execute sourcing and procurement strategies that drive value creation and improved business capability. The Manager will be responsible for managing technology acquisitions from WBD’s mid-tier and top-tier technology partnerships, with a primary focus on deal negotiation and strategy in the technical and professional services 

fields. Responsibilities will include managing sourcing & competitive events for more complex technology acquisitions, contract planning and negotiation, creating and implementing category strategies and development of sourcing and relationship management policies. 

The Daily 
Manager will manage sourcing projects and will handle business and technical contract negotiations for mid-tier and top-tier technology transactions, including: 

Gathering requirements from relevant WBD stakeholders. 

Reading, interpreting, understanding, and communicating technology contract terms. 

Partnering with legal to understand legal concepts and challenges, and problem solve to overcome challenges. 

Working with Finance and Business Stakeholders to identify budgetary constraints and develop desired set of commercial terms. 

Negotiating pricing and other commercial terms, as well as Statements of Work, Service Level Agreements, and other technical/operational documents. 

Owning overall responsibility for delivering finalized agreements in accordance with applicable timing requirements and other relevant factors. 

Serving as negotiation lead on deal terms including presenting position, counters, and developing fallbacks to produce material savings, improved terms and conditions, and risk reduction for WBD. 

Managing the request for proposal/quote/information (RFX) process and the competitive bid process for technology vendor selection, where applicable. 

Deliver cost savings through daily work and through driving proactive cost savings initiatives as part of WBD’s Technology Sourcing team. 

The Manager will be responsible to lead the technology vendor and procurement strategy, including: 

Act as liaison for Technology Business Unit Stakeholders across Legal, Finance, Security, and Procurement and other WBD departments throughout contract negotiation and relationship management process. 

Implement knowledge of sourcing, contract negotiation and relationship management best practices and industry trends. 

Identify areas of opportunity in partner categories e.g., supplier and technology rationalizations 

Manager will act as an WBD business representative conducting relationship management for WBD mid and top tier technology vendors, including: 

Managing WBD’s business relationships with vendors, focusing on business issues, escalations, and other non-operational matters. 

Planning and managing vendor business reviews; analyzing and rating key vendors. 

Developing supplier debriefing materials to address performance issues and identify opportunities to improve relationships 

Preparing and delivering briefing documents, status reporting, and other data/reports on key WBD’s technology relationships for senior management. 

Advising and consulting with clients on market trends, technology, new products, and training. 

Building strong internal client relationships and serve as a trusted advisor and partner. 

Maintaining accurate contracting data, vendor records, and transaction information. 

Manager will provide support to the processing and operations functions of the TSS team, including: 

Overseeing the request for proposal/quote/information (RFX) process and the competitive bid process for technology vendor selection, where applicable. 

Identifying and assessing technology vendors/products from a strategic perspective, to ensure that vendor/product selection is aligned with WBD’s Technology objectives and strategies. 

Assessing impact of technology purchases on other parts of the WBD organization, domestically and globally 

Ensuring compliance with WBD’s sourcing & procurement policies. 

Identifying areas for process improvement, providing recommendations, and working within cross-functional teams to implement changes and improvements to create operational efficiency, savings, improve WBD partner relationships, or mitigate risks. 

The Essentials 

BS/BA degree (business/technology) required; advanced degree JD/MBA a plus. 

8+ years of experience in sourcing, or related field preferably for leading technology/data/media companies. Experience in technology and media & entertainment; especially managing technical and professional services suppliers 

Advanced Level of english. 

Experience evaluating technology and data vendors, category management and support rationalizing vendors and consolidating agreements. 

Exceptional negotiation skills for both internal and external negotiations and the ability to coach and develop others to do the same. 

Works on complex issues where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors. 

Develops financial models, including present mode of operation (PMO) and future mode of operation (FMO), to determine business case for deal or comparison between multiple vendors 

Exercises impartial judgment in selecting methods and evaluation criteria for obtaining results or evaluating supplier responses to RFXs. 

Identify opportunities that could benefit multiple business units by understanding the landscape and impact of supplier’s collective business across WBD. 

Stays current on market intelligence to assist in negotiation effectiveness. 

Must be flexible and adapt to the ever-changing business needs of technology and advertising clients, be able to work well under pressure in a fast-paced and evolving environment 

Ability to own and drive deals to execution and will need to build collaborative relationships in multi-functional teams and have a problem-solving mindset to do so. 

Team player, self-starter, and quick learning with interpersonal and solution-oriented attitude and an ability to effectively operate with high energy and flexibility in a fast-paced cross functional environment; able to prioritize tasks and projects accordingly. 

Ability to identify and deconstruct issues to overcome obstacles. 

Exceptional written and verbal communications/interpersonal skills, research/analytical skills, and presentation communication skills 

Ability to work across global teams and work non-traditional hours, as needed 

Advanced proficiency in MS Word, MS Excel, and MS PowerPoint. 

Experience using Ariba, CLM tools, SpendHQ, and Scout preferred. 




How We Get Things Done…

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

Championing Inclusion at WBD

Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, union status, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.

About the job

Partner Activation and Acceleration Team (PAAT) | P&A Strategy & Operations

Mexico City, MX

The Partner Activation and Acceleration Specialist is an individual contributor role within the Strategy & Operations (S&O) team, part of Thomson Reuters' Partnerships & Alliances organization. This role is both partner-facing and internally focused: you will serve as a valued point of contact for partners through their onboarding and activation journey while driving the internal cross-functional coordination, process rigor, and operational discipline that makes partner success possible. You will be pivotal in reducing onboarding and activation time and improving time-to-revenue for both partners and TR across global segments, including Legal Professionals, Tax, Audit and Accounting Professionals, Corporates, and Government. You will execute and continuously improve the mechanisms and frameworks that accelerate partner sales, directly supporting TR's goal of a 3x increase in P&A sales contribution by 2028.

You will collaborate closely with Sales, Product, Commercial Excellence, Finance, Pricing, Legal, and Partner Specialists to embed partners at the core of TR's go-to-market, sales, and innovation processes. You will be expected to manage up to 15 partners concurrently, will ensure scalable, measurable, and partner-centric activation, and you will play a key role in the evolution of the Partner Activation and Acceleration Team (PAAT) operating model. This role requires high ownership, solutions orientation, comfort with ambiguity, and a relentless customer and partner obsession. You will operate in an environment where processes are still being built; the ability to make sound decisions with incomplete information and bring a proposed path forward with every problem is essential.

About The Role

In this opportunity as Partner Activation and Acceleration Specialist, P&A Strategy & Operations, you will:


Own partner onboarding, activation, and acceleration across assigned regions and segments, reducing time-to-activation and improving partner time-to-revenue. 
Identify bottlenecks in the onboarding and activation journey, monitor partner progress, document findings, and create training materials and process improvements that increase partner productivity and win rates. 
Collaborate with Partner Specialists, Sales, Commercial Excellence, Pricing, Legal, and cross-functional stakeholders to resolve partner issues and embed scalable activation practices into day-to-day operations. 
Support pricing analyses for new, renewal, and upsell/cross-sell offerings in partnership channels, leveraging regional partner and market insights to drive competitive advantage. 
Contribute to the development and maintenance of PAAT playbooks, SOPs, and workflows, fostering a culture of partnership, innovation, and continuous improvement. 
Work effectively across cultures and multiple time zones alongside US-based P&A leadership and regional counterparts in NAMER and Europe. 
Support the Senior Director, PAAT on special projects and contribute to the ongoing evolution of the P&A Strategy & Operations operating model. 


Location

The successful candidates will be based in Mexico City, Mexico and work in a hybrid environment, spending a minimum of 3 days per week in office. Candidates should be comfortable with cross-time-zone collaboration with US-based leadership.

About You

You're a fit for the role of Partner Activation and Acceleration Specialist if your background includes:


Bachelor's degree in business, Marketing, Finance, or related field preferred. 
5+ years of experience in partnerships, alliances, partner onboarding, business development, or related roles, preferably within enterprise software. 
Demonstrated ability to manage deal workflows, SLAs, and operational processes in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. 
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills; comfortable engaging with sales and commercial teams at all levels. 
Experience working in global, matrixed organizations and driving process improvement initiatives. 
High ownership mindset takes initiative without waiting for direction and holds themselves accountable to outcomes, not just activity. 
Solutions orientation brings a proposed path forward with every problem and does not escalate without a recommendation. 
Comfort with ambiguity makes sound decisions with incomplete information and thrives in environments where the playbook is still being written. 
Customer and partner obsessed: measures success by partner outcomes and advocates for the partner experience in every cross-functional conversation. 
Builder mindset: energized by creating scalable structure and process where little currently exists. 
Bias for action moves with urgency, iterates quickly, and does not wait for perfect before making progress. 
Keen interest in AI technologies and proficiency in using AI tools in the workplace. 
Resourceful and highly organized self-starter with the ability to juggle multiple priorities and operate successfully in a complex, dynamic, fast-paced, and continuously evolving environment. 
Fluency in English required; Spanish fluency recommended for all Mexico and Spain-based roles. 
Ability to travel as needed. 


What’s in it For You?


Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.


About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.

We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here.

Learn more on how to protect yourself from fraudulent job postings here.

More information about Thomson Reuters can be found on thomsonreuters.com

description:
About the job

Overview

CARRERAS PARA SONREÍR


Disponibilidad para trabajar en un esquema de operación 24/7, incluyendo turnos nocturnos y/o fines de semana, de acuerdo con las necesidades de la operación.*


En PepsiCo, descubrirás un lugar donde nuestra misión es crear sonrisas alrededor del mundo. Con más de 500 marcas queridas, incluyen Gatorade, Lay's y Quaker y nuestro trabajo llega a millones de personas cada día.

En el corazón de nuestra compañía hay un equipo de pensadores y creadores que colaboran para innovar y convertir las ideas en acciones. Impulsados por la innovación y centrados en crear momentos de alegría a través de los alimentos y bebidas, nuestras decisiones se guían por y para el consumidor, creando oportunidades para que nuestros asociados realicen un trabajo significativo y tengan un impacto duradero en las comunidades a las que servimos.

Sea cual sea tu función, formarás parte de una comunidad global que valora tus ideas y te empodera para que tengas impacto en tu carrera y en el mundo que te rodea.

Responsibilities

La Oportunidad

Garantizar la ejecución diaria del plan de carga y la disponibilidad de camiones para las cuatro cadenas de transporte (OT, Wholesale, Interplant y DTS), cubriendo un vacío operativo que hoy recae sobre Procurement ante la falta de capacidad de respuesta de la Torre de Control de Transporte (TCT). El rol reacciona en tiempo real a desviaciones, garantiza el SLA de arribo de transportistas, monitorea la calidad de los proveedores ejecutando planes de mejora y desarrollo de nuevos transportistas, y ejecuta el sourcing conforme a la estrategia de categoría, asegurando continuidad de suministro y un reporte único y alineado con TCT/OM.

Tu impacto

Como Indirect Sr. Coordinator tus responsabilidades constarían de…


Ejecutar sourcing alineado a la estrategia de categoría, asegurando continuidad de suministro y reporte alineado a TCT/OM/Procurement.,
Monitorear la calidad de los transportistas, ejecutando planes de mejora y desarrollando nuevos proveedores.,
Garantizar el SLA de arribo puntual de transportistas y la colocación de camiones para el plan de viajes diario.,
Alinear y ejecutar el plan de carga diario con OM y TCT, monitoreando la ejecución en tiempo real y reaccionando a desviaciones.,
Monitorear la calidad de los transportistas, ejecutando planes de mejora y desarrollando nuevos proveedores.


Qualifications

¿A quién buscamos?


Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Logistics, Supply Chain, or a related field. 2–4 years of experience in transportation/logistics operations, control tower, or procurement.
Excel proficiency; SAP or TMS/control tower systems is a plus.
Familiarity with digital tools, AI, and process automation applied to logistics/procurement operations.


Si esta es una oportunidad que te interesa, te alentamos a postularte aún si no cumples con el 100% de los requisitos.

Lo que puedes esperar de nosotros:


Oportunidades para aprender y desarrollarte todos los días a través de una amplia oferta de programas. 
Plataformas internas digitales que promueven el self-learning. 
Programas de desarrollo de acuerdo con habilidades de Liderazgo. 
Entrenamientos especializados de acuerdo con el rol. 
Experiencias de aprendizaje con proveedores internos y externos. 
Nos encanta celebrar el éxito, por lo que contamos con programas de reconocimiento por antigüedad, comportamientos, liderazgo, momentos de vida, entre otros. 
Programas de bienestar financiero que te ayudarán a alcanzar tus metas en todas las etapas de la vida. 
Un programa de flexibilidad que te permitirá balancear tu vida personal y laboral, adaptando tu jornada laboral a tu estilo de vida. 
Y porque tu familia también es importante para nosotros, ellos también pueden gozar de beneficios como nuestra Línea de Bienestar, miles de Convenios y Descuentos, programas de Becas para tus hijos, Planes de Ayuda para diferentes momentos de vida, entre otros. 


En PepsiCo, estamos comprometidos con impulsar un equipo de trabajo diverso al crear un espacio colaborativo, equitativo e incluyente, en donde todos y todas independientemente de cómo nos vemos, de dónde somos o a quién amamos- tengamos una voz. Ofrecemos oportunidades únicas para contratar personas calificadas y diversas, independientemente de su género, raza, orientación sexual, religión, nacionalidad, edad o discapacidad.
